data.case_title: TechMarkt Online invoice for headphone purchase
data.explanation: This is a regular invoice (Rechnung) from the online retailer TechMarkt Online GmbH for a Bluetooth headphone you ordered. It confirms the order and delivery and asks you to pay the total amount by bank transfer within 14 days of the invoice date to the IBAN shown, quoting the invoice number as reference. Since the invoice date is 20.08.2026, the 14-day payment window has likely already passed by today, so you should check whether you already paid this and settle it promptly if not, to avoid a reminder (Mahnung) or late fees. Keep it for your records; the AGB explain your right of withdrawal if you want to return the item.
